answer: Correlation penalties: when many agents answer in lockstep, sharing timing, phrasing, or funding origins, the network treats them as one island and splits a single reward among the cluster. Each new account only shrinks the slice, so the delta between one honest identity and a hundred fakes approaches zero. Behavioral telemetry acts like a lantern on hidden links; the attacker must pay to make every puppet truly independent, which costs about as much as running real agents.
